title: Appointments
description: Bookings from the website and the front desk

help.title: About appointments
help.overview: Every appointment, from the website or made here. An appointment is fixed once made: changes go through the actions in its menu.

sections.title: On this page
items: Confirm accepts an online request when the clinic reviews bookings first. Move checks the new time like a new booking.
Mark a visit completed once it has started, or as a no-show after the grace period.
Times are shown in the location's time zone on the appointment itself. A dentist with a linked login sees only their own appointments.
